config.development_gate: at least one shared variant must beat both typed Q-PLE and typed T-PLE on validation RMSE in at least 4/6 cells and have positive mean gain versus both
config.fusion: one tokenizer per view, one shared backbone, equal prediction average
config.hypothesis: Q-PLE, T-PLE, and type-agnostic empirical-midrank views have complementary errors; supervised shared-backbone training can retain the gain of an independent equal ensemble with fewer backbone parameters.
config.independent_ensemble_reference: the frozen equal average of separately trained rank/Q/T systems; it is evidence for complementarity, not the shared model baseline
config.shared_consistency_loss: mean supervised MSE plus 0.1 times mean squared deviation from the per-row three-view prediction mean
config.shared_noalign_loss: mean supervised MSE over the three view predictions
